35:     item.keywords.some((word) => text.includes(word))

37:   if (!rule) return ''

39: }

41: /**

43:  * @param {string} title
44:  * @returns {string}

46: export function resolveNavbarIconKey(title) {
47:   const text = String(title || '').trim()
48:   if (['首页', '主页', '工作台', '工作中心'].some((word) => text.includes(word))) return 'home'
49:   const path = resolveMenuPlatformIconPath(title, 'line')
50:   if (!path) return 'grid'
51:   const base = path.split('/').pop().replace(/\.svg$/, '')
52:   return base.replace(/^\d+-/, '')
53: }
